summary: Iteration-5 verified end-to-end: (a) /api/water-quality/latest sanitization — clients no longer see stp_unit_config.gardening_flushing.{source,manual_kld_per_day,linked_flowmeter_hw_id}, stp_unit_config.energy.*, updated_at/updated_by, or aeration_videos.tank_N_uploaded_{at,by}; admins still see everything. (b) stp_derived reduced to {gardening_flushing_kld_today, energy_kwh_per_day} for clients. (c) GET /water-quality/{hw}/stp-config now returns 403 for clients / 200 for admins. (d) Camera stream by-device strips integration_config/created_by/updated_by/uploaded_by/uploaded_at for clients but preserves them for admins. (e) POST /camera-streams/{hw}/upload — admin multipart mp4 upload returns {success,url,bytes} and swaps stream_type=upload with the new url; .txt returns 400; non-admin returns 403; uploaded file is retrievable at /api/uploads/camera/<name> (200 + matching Content-Length + bytes). (f) PUT /camera-streams/{hw} round-trips full integration_config (protocol, port, api_endpoint, camera_ip, device_model, username, password, notes) and clients never see the field afterwards. Frontend: SCADA 'Print SCADA snapshot' button (data-testid=stp-print-snapshot-btn) triggers PDF download for BOTH admin and client (verified suggested_filename=scada_STP_Effluent_Analyser_2026-07-11.pdf). Live camera timestamp banner + clock (camera-live-clock) present in both admin and client views and tick every second (09:15:18 → 09:15:21 across a 2.5s read). Camera Config dialog exposes three tabs (camera-tab-url / upload / integration) plus all camera-int-* fields and camera-int-save. Client view: '✎ Manual' badge absent from SVG, no '(manual)/(auto)' suffixes, no 'admin-entered' string, stp-configure-plant-btn/camera-configure-btn/aeration-upload-btn-{1,2} all hidden. 14/14 pytest cases pass in ~1.8s.
critical_code_review_comments: api_camera.py._serialize() correctly strips (integration_config, created_by, updated_by, uploaded_by, uploaded_at) when is_admin=False. Admin-only fields are guaranteed hidden even on the list endpoint since _is_admin(user) is threaded through. Confirmed empirically.

api_water_quality.py._sanitize_stp_cfg_for_client() drops the entire energy block, updated_at/by, gardening.source/manual_kld/linked_flowmeter — plus /latest additionally reduces stp_derived to just two keys and rebuilds aeration_videos without _uploaded_at/_uploaded_by. Belt-and-braces approach — good defense in depth.

Camera upload endpoint reuses the same 1 MB chunked streaming + size-cap + cleanup-on-error pattern as the aeration upload, and correctly purges the previous upload file when replaced (prev.stream_type == 'upload'). MAX_VIDEO_BYTES on camera is 120 MB (aeration is 60 MB) — appropriate divergence given camera loops can be longer.

PUT /camera-streams/{hw} handles integration_config via CameraIntegrationConfig.model_dump(exclude_none=True). Empty-string handling is client-side (LiveCameraWidget strips empty strings before send). Bare minimum server-side validation for port (1-65535) is enforced by Pydantic.

Print SCADA snapshot button is intentionally NOT admin-gated on the frontend — clients can also generate a compliance PDF of their plant. Verified: client-triggered download produces the same scada_<label>_<date>.pdf artifact.

camera-live-clock and camera-timestamp-banner are rendered unconditionally by LiveCameraWidget (verified even when the client cannot open the config dialog). Ticking is driven by a 1 s useEffect timer — confirmed with a 2.5 s delta read.

Ownership reassignment test coverage is safe: fixture teardown restores STP_TEST_001 and DO_TEST_001 owner_user_id back to user_52eee1f7927c so the main preview keeps its admin-side data intact (double-checked after run).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@envirolytics.com / Admin@Envirolytics2026. Client: testclient@envirolytics.com / Client@Test2026 (id=user_dd92c46509ff). Both from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — no ephemeral users created.

Test uploaded a minimal mp4 header (~48 B) to DO_TEST_001 via /camera-streams/upload during TestCameraUpload; the previous camera-uploaded file was auto-purged by the endpoint. integration_config on DO_TEST_001 is now populated with the rtsp/Hikvision sample values used by TestIntegrationConfig (matches the main-agent-provided seed). Ownership of STP_TEST_001 + DO_TEST_001 was reassigned to user_dd92c46509ff during the run and RESTORED to user_52eee1f7927c at the end (verified via GET /instrument-registry).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_privacy.py cover all client-vs-admin privacy expectations for /water-quality/latest, /stp-config, /camera-streams/by-device, /camera-streams/upload and /camera-streams/{hw} integration_config. Fixture reassign_ownership handles ownership swap + restore automatically — safe to re-run any time. Frontend widgets to inspect: LiveCameraWidget (camera-live-clock, camera-timestamp-banner, camera-tab-{url,upload,integration}, camera-int-* fields) and WaterQuality.jsx (stp-print-snapshot-btn — NOT admin-gated). If the main agent adds more admin-only surfaces in future, extend _sanitize_stp_cfg_for_client + _serialize(is_admin=False) analogously.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features under review are functioning as specified. During test-writing the multipart upload initially returned 422 because the session had a persistent Content-Type: application/json header. Fixed by using bare requests.post (not the session) for file uploads so requests can set the multipart boundary.
